source_row.rationale: While BCMA override functionality may sometimes be necessary for legitimate clinical reasons, it should be used cautiously, only after the nurse carefully verifies the situation and confirms it is genuinely safe to proceed, since research has shown that frequent, routine, or careless overriding of BCMA alerts undermines the safety value of the system and has been associated with medication errors reaching the patient.
source_row.source_detail: Appropriate, Cautious Use of BCMA Override Functionality
